- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cuckoo chicks mimic the begging calls of host bird chicks, tricking the host bird into feeding them.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Negative consequences for host birds include reduced number of host bird chicks that successfully fledge and increased energetic costs of feeding cuckoo chicks.
